sentences.text:
Petitioners
 Mr. Upendra Kumar Samal, Advocate
 -versus-
 Union of India and others ....

Opposite Parties
 Mr. Manmaya Kumar Dash, A.S.C.
 Mr. Mahendra Kumar Pradhan, Cgc
 Coram:
 Justice K.R. Mohapatra
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
Order No. 09.07.2025
 01. 1.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Mr. Samal, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that although an award under Section 3(G)
of the National Highways Authority Act, 1956 has been passed since long.
But, the compensation has not yet been released by Opposite Party No.3, namely, the Competent Authority-cum-Land Acquisition Officer, National Highway No.20, Jajpur.
3. In view of the limited grievance of the Petitioner, this Court feels that notice should be issued only to Opposite Party No.3 for securing his response.
4. Mr. Samal, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that notice on Opposite Party No.3 may be issued by special messenger.
6. Requisites for issuance of notice be filed and special messenger cost be assessed and deposited by 11th July, 2025 by the Petitioner.
On deposit of the special messenger cost and requisites, notice shall be issued forthwith to the Opposite Party No.3 fixing 22nd July, 2025 to be the date of appearance.

7. Put up this matter on 31st July, 2025 along with service report.
